representation.name: ENCODE ATAC 2.2.3 layout probe
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
{
printf '%s\n' 'software top:'
ls -la /software
printf '%s\n' 'pipeline top:'
ls -la /software/atac-seq-pipeline
printf '%s\n' 'scripts:'
find /software/atac-seq-pipeline -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
printf '%s\n' 'jars:'
find /software -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name '*.jar' -o -name 'cromwell*' \) 2>/dev/null | sort
printf '%s\n' 'bin hits:'
find /usr /software -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name 'cromwell' -o -name 'java' -o -name 'croo' -o -name 'qc2tsv' \) 2>/dev/null | sort
} > layout.txt
